name: @workerv2/manifest
description: Worker V2 Manifest Platform — the immutable, deterministic, content-addressable description of EXECUTABLE WORK derived from a Blueprint: manifest model (work nodes with explicit consumed/produced artifact bindings), declarative compiler (blueprint intent → processing intent), processing/dependency graph, validation, canonical serialization, hashing, schema versioning, diff model, and the bridge to the declarative Processing Framework. Reuses the processing policy/capability/binding contracts. Pure data + pure functions; NO execution, NO scheduling, NO rendering, NO storage.
